simple.meaning: עֲרָפֶל (ʻărâphel) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “gloom (as of a lowering sky).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 15 times across Exodus, Deuteronomy, 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, 2 Chronicles, and 7 more, beginning at Exodus 20:21. Its contexts include mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֲרָפֶל (H6205).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: עֲרָפֶל (ʻărâphel) / H6205 is traced through Exodus 20:21, Deuteronomy 4:11, Deuteronomy 5:22, 2 Samuel 22:10 as a generated source-based concept entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.

timeline.evidenceText: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.
You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.

Yahweh spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.
He bowed the heavens also, and came down.
Then Solomon said, “Yahweh has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
Then Solomon said, “Yahweh has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
when I made clouds its garment,
He rode on a cherub, and flew.
Clouds and darkness are around him.
For, behold, darkness will cover the earth,
Give glory to Yahweh your God,

As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so I will seek out my sheep. I will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
A day of darkness and gloominess,
That day is a day of wrath, a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,
